campaign.h1: Cómo crear fondos y conceptos visuales con IA para campañas de perfumes

decisions.reason: Insufficient verified identity and review evidence: workbook targets Begosmujerbonita Perfums Dubai in Calpe; current homepage identifies Begos Mujer Bonita at Calle Real 28, Torrejón de la Calzada, Madrid. Nicanora lists Av. Gabriel Miró 38, Calpe and internally inconsistent ratings/counts. Cannot attribute reviews or reputation across these identities without primary confirmation. Revisit after business identity is reconciled.

Cannibalization: current Spanish query results center on economical Arabic fragrances, alternatives to luxury/niche and equivalences. Existing live guides mejores-perfumes-arabes-baratos and mejores-equivalencias-de-perfumes-arabes already serve this purchase decision with product comparisons, scent-family alternatives, budget and blind-buy checks. No sufficiently distinct broad article warranted by this workbook keyword.

serp_notes: Brand query: local directory/reputation intent; Nicanora fetched in full, no attributable primary customer-review dataset. Homepage and workbook identity conflict.

Alternatives query: commercial lists, designer/niche equivalences, comparison tables and FAQs. CompraClave and Daytemis fetched; Daytemis is Peru context only, not Spanish pricing evidence. Existing site equivalence article surfaced in results.
Reviewed repository and fetched both live overlapping articles. No article drafted; product claims, prices and ratings from competitors were not adopted.
fetch_limits: AlicanteTop and PerfumesDupes returned cache misses; not used as fetched evidence.
